title: Fix rename drag and drop staging
summary: Restored Rename drag/drop staging in the Tauri shell and fixed dropped folder handling so folders resolve through backend folder_files browse into direct media child paths instead of being staged as one non-media folder path.
reason: The Rename WebView could receive browser drop events, but the Tauri shell did not expose OS drag/drop paths to the page. Browser File.name fallback also risked staging bare filenames that are not actionable filesystem paths. Dropped folders also needed to reuse the backend folder-file enumeration path so drag/drop matches Add files from folder.
behavior_before: Dragging files or folders onto the Rename drop zone in the Tauri/WebView shell did not stage usable paths. Browser fallback could treat a bare File.name as a path, producing misleading staged entries. A dropped folder path could be staged as one non-media path with 0 media instead of expanding to media files.
behavior_after: The Tauri shell exposes loopback-scoped read-only event access, the bridge re-dispatches Tauri drag/drop payloads as mediapipeline:file-drop events, and the Rename page stages only backend-resolved media paths from drops. Dropped folders use the same non-recursive folder_files media filtering as Add files from folder and report ignored sidecar/non-media counts.
